claims.statement: For MSR6 in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program with the exact exhaustive branch for n<2^20 and the integer-parameter quantum-counted rank/hash tree and known-frequency decoder otherwise recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its total charged sequential work T=O(n^128 2^((13/16) sqrt(n) sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all other resource bounds and clean law below. All outside constants are absolute. All oracle/query gates are expanded as literal row circuits; coherent median storage, private preparations, addressing, generated circuits, failed attempts and source/work caps are included. The huge disclosed finite-range outside constants make no practical speed claim.

All oracle/query gates are expanded as literal row circuits; coherent median storage, private preparations, addressing, generated circuits, failed attempts and source/work caps are included. For the SAME MSR6 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
